strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Ngh, is this my limit...
He held out well... Is this the power of what they call a Newtype?
With Jaburo in that state... who knows what's become of the Federation...
Capture him alive if at all possible!
He's a valuable source of information on Jaburo's situation.
I've sent a distress signal. Now... can I hold out...!?
Kamille!
Fa? Is that you, Fa!? Are you riding that dragon!?
Ngh, that's the Far East Branch's...!
Looks like a troublesome foe has shown up... Send reinforcements!
Kamille Bidan, I presume?
This is the Federation Forces Far East Branch, the Gandor Team.
We'll provide support now. Please join up with us.
Understood. I'm counting on you...!
That Gouf again...! I'm going out!
That enemy lineup... Commander, aren't those Titans mobile suits!?
Indeed. After Paptimus Scirocco's rebellion,
there were rumors that the technology had leaked to Neo Zeon...
So it was true...!?
Heh, these are easier to fight than tough Mechanical Beasts.
You said it. Let's smash 'em all at once!
Doesn't mean much if you can't hit 'em, you two.
Why you little...!
But they evade better. Power means nothing if you can't hit them.
True... I hate the nimble ones.
At a disadvantage in strength... I hope they arrive in time.
Whoa, a whole bunch of stuff is flying in! Show!
Enemy reinforcements!?
Bring on as many as you like!
As many as they like would be a problem, Benkei.
Titans high-mobility types...!
What...? This feeling... Four... Can it be, Four!?
Kamille!? Four... Four is gone!
Drop the sky... the enemies who drop the sky... that's them...!
Could it be... a Cyber-Newtype? Lord Ginias... what foolishness...!
Four!? ...No... you're... Rosamie? That's it, Rosamia Badam!
How awful...! The Titans have fallen, and still another war!
Wh-Who are you...! Stay away!
Don't you know me!? Rosamie, it's Kamille, your big brother!
...Ugh... my head... what... big brother...?
That's right, Rosamie. It's Kamille, your big brother!
Rosamie...!
Ugh, uuh... Big... brother...?
That's right, Rosamie, you mustn't become a tool of war!
Come with me... and live for Four too...!
Big brother...!
Acquired skill "SP+15".
What!? What is that!?
Enemy reinforcements!? What the heck is that round thing!?
Eeek!
That's... the Apsaras...! It should still be incomplete. Who's in it!?
Did I shake them off?
To keep up with the Apsaras and a Gaplant, even unfinished ones...
Something else showed up! What's that big rice-cake-looking thing!?
No visible thrusters, so how is it floating... Minovsky Craft...?
A Zaku head!? I see, they're using it as the main monitor!
Norris? Norris!
...Lady Aina!? Why are you in a place like this!?
The Apsaras Project is behind schedule.
And the surface is already in such chaos...
Brother told me to come here as a test flight, even if it's risky.
What... a new model I've never seen...
Damn Zeon, when did they build a mobile armor that big...
Re-GZ?
Geez, they just keep on coming.
Ngh, this is no time for people of Earth to fight each other!
...No? This is... it's him!
Kamille?
Guess I couldn't get this unit perfectly tuned...
...Captain Amuro!
Captain Amuro!? The Argama's former ace pilot...!
This is Amuro Ray. I'll back you up!
I never thought I'd meet the real deal.
So that's the pilot of the original Gundam...
Everyone's sure making a fuss.
Not much news from the Earth Sphere reached Mars, but...
he seems to be a powerful ally, anyway.
Heh, now if that guy shows up too, we'll be unstoppable.
The unit's stability...!? Ngh, withdrawing from the battle...!
That Zaku-head... it's running!
We only drove it back.
A facility that can build a mobile armor like that... on Earth?
Tobikage!?
So that's the ninja robot everyone's talking about?
I see. Calling it a ninja is spot on.
Another one!?
A unit I've never seen...? It's awfully small...
Everyone, that's on our side!
...Don't tell me Tobikage was listening to me?
We managed to drive off Zeon.
Amuro, Bidan, thanks for coming... Let's hear the details on the bridge.
Rosamie...
Cyber-Newtypes like her are being used in war again...
It's a sad reality...
Still, I can't believe Zeon can afford to produce new models.
That Zaku-head thing, right?
Maybe they have a secret base somewhere.
On the way here, I intercepted several Zeon transmissions.
If we analyze them, we might learn something...
All right, everyone, return to the ship for now.
